name: Page Visibility, focus and blur
plain: Tells a page when its tab is hidden, backgrounded or unfocused.
meaning: Sites learn when the person switches tabs, minimizes or locks the screen. Used for attention tracking, exam proctoring and ad viewability, and by bot detectors that expect focus events.

limits.headline: Can tell when you switch tabs, minimise the browser or lock the screen
limits.user_action: You switch tabs, minimise the window or lock the screen
can: Learn when the tab is shown or hidden
Learn when the window loses focus
Time how long you look at an ad or a page
Check that you are really there, as exam tools and bot checks do
cannot: See what you do in other tabs or apps

story.what_it_is: A page can tell when its tab is hidden, in the background or when you click away from it.

marketing.name: Page Visibility API
marketing.pitch: Lets a page know when it is visible or hidden, so it can pause work and save power.

story.for_you: You never see a prompt. A video may pause when you switch tabs, a game may stop, and a site may notice you went away. It is how pages save battery, and how some sites know you looked elsewhere.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to pause video, stop animations and save power. It also powers ad viewability, which only counts an ad when the tab is visible, and some exam and training sites flag tab switches.

use_cases.example: A video site pauses when you switch tabs, then resumes when you return.
A browser game pauses the match when you switch away, so you do not lose while away.
An ad measurement script only counts an ad as seen when the tab is visible and in view.
An online exam tool records each time a student leaves the test tab.
A web chat app only sends a read receipt when the tab is visible, and sends a notification when it is hidden.
A live stream stops loading video chunks in a hidden tab to save data and power.
A site measures true time on page by pausing the timer when the tab is hidden.

risks: Exams may flag honest tab switches

technical_bounds: Cannot see which other tab or app
Background timers throttled to 1 per second then 1 per minute
